title: Getting Started sample audio buttons point at API Gateway URLs that return Not Found
description:
**Problem**
The three Sample Audio URLs on https://aurit.us/docs/getting-started point at API Gateway job redeem links that no longer exist, so the sample playback does not work.

**Evidence**
site/components/GettingStartedWizard.tsx:104, :116, :128 (Kokoro `jobs/e2e-kokoro-final/redeem`, Qwen `jobs/407fefa6.../redeem`, Higgs `jobs/6f8084e9/redeem`). Each returns HTTP 404 with `{"message":"Not Found"}` on 2026-10-20, for example `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://4o6atlkpeh.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/jobs/6f8084e9/redeem`.

**Fix**
Generate durable sample audio (for example static files under site/public, or a CDN object) and point the three entries at them. Do not depend on job redeem links, which expire.

**How to verify**
Each audioSampleUrl returns 200 with an audio content type, and the Play buttons on /docs/getting-started play.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
